summary: Backend smoke + business-logic verification of Luxury Salon Suite MVP. Auth (owner/manager JWT via Bearer), POS auto-seed (48 rows on 2026-06-26), Staff (8), SKUs (12), Daily/Monthly/Manager Incentives, Payouts (owner-only, upsert idempotent), Inventory Checkout (manager) & Receive (owner-only), Purchase Orders (reorder_point=velocity*4*1.5), Config (owner-only PUT), Owner Dashboard, Quality failures — all verified against expected values.
passed: POST /api/auth/login owner returns user+token; wrong password -> 401
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer returns user; without token -> 401
GET /api/staff -> 8 staff incl. jahangir, Lhd Faid, Ashu stylist, Beauty Anju, Mhd Sadik, Pedi Sameer, navneet, mhd alam

GET /api/incentives/daily?day=2026-06-26 -> 8 rows; jahangir svc=13840 bonus=500 retail_comm=286.88 (9562.71*3%); Mhd Sadik svc=10071 bonus=500; Pedi Sameer svc=5300 bonus=200; Beauty Anju svc=4500 bonus=100
GET /api/incentives/monthly?month=2026-06 -> 8 rows with ratio vs base_salary=25000
POST /api/payouts/confirm (owner) OK and idempotent (upsert by staff_id+payout_date -> payouts count remains 1 after two calls)
POST /api/inventory/checkout (manager) decrements store (17->15) and increments floor (3->5); checkout log record created
action_items: Optional: POS re-import idempotency via POST /api/pos/upload with the Geetanjali CSV file was not executed end-to-end (only startup auto-seed idempotency indirectly validated by 48-row stable state). Consider a manual re-upload smoke test.
Minor UX: /api/payouts/confirm requires body {staff_id, payout_date, amount, breakdown}. If frontend expects a bulk 'confirm month' endpoint, add one; otherwise ensure UI iterates per staff.
